#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

int main() {
    int n, b;
    std::cin >> n >> b;
    std::vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cin >> a[i];
    }
    std::vector<int> diff;
    int even = (a[0] % 2 == 0) ? 1 : 0;
    int odd = (a[0] % 2 == 1) ? 1 : 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
        if (even == odd) {
            diff.push_back(std::abs(a[i] - a[i - 1]));
        }
        if (a[i] % 2 == 0) {
            even++;
        } else {
            odd++;
        }
    }
    std::sort(diff.begin(), diff.end());
    long long sum = 0;
    int count = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < diff.size(); ++i) {
        if (diff[i] + sum <= b) {
            ++count;
            sum += diff[i];
        }
    }
    std::cout << count << "\n";
    return 0;
}
